I am incredibly proud of Southside Virginia's involvement in the #BlackLivesMatter movement: from Halifax to Danville to Martinsville - people of all races and backgrounds came together in hopes of unity. We will continue to work for justice.
#RestInPower #TrayvonMartinStory https://t.co/6fYE1HagBM

Glanced at #MorningJoe (please, don't judge me), they were discussing #MeToo as if it's a year old campaign...

No.

Sista @TaranaBurke has been working on this project for over a decade - this international movement is her life's work.

Get. With. It. https://t.co/4sfNI110We

Oh my God: an officer is being held accountable for their actions!

My heart goes out to the family of #LaquanMcdonald - nothing we say can bring comfort, but I pray this provides some closure.

#BlackLivesMatter

How do we fix this, guys?

merely tweeting our sadness and rage, without action, we bare some blame in this crisis we face.

Trump isn't patient zero, he is the result of Americans being negligent.

We are responsible, too.

#MAGABomber #Pittsburgh #Charlottesville #BLM #resist

While the hate crime in #Pittsburgh and bomb mailings are horrible and gut-wrenching, please remember #CurtisAdams, #MauriceStallard, and #VickieJones - we lost them to hate and fear as well. We must speak for them as well.

#BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/HXOROOELqY
